attribution.title: Tileable Science Production 1.0-2.0 - Early to Mid Game (Vanilla): Automation Science 1.5/s (Gear-input)
attribution.author: Christoffer Ramqvist

description: Automation science from copper plates and gears: two columns of science assemblers around a copper belt and a gear belt
notes: assembling-machine-2 -> assembling-machine-1 (v1 tier, D20); constant combinators (labels) removed
the bus connection (undergrounds above the tile) is cropped; the belts' top tiles are the ports
the pass-through underground from the tile below (bottom of the output chain) is removed

B25: the copper and gear belts no longer run off the bottom edge (they would spill onto belts passing the module): their last tiles turn west (into an empty tile) and east (into the inserter that picks from it)
expand: the tile repeats every 6 rows (4 science assemblers); units are copies of rows 2-7
